createAtBootstrap.name: Voice Agent Platform daily orchestration drift
createAtBootstrap.prompt: Read-only orchestration drift report. Inspect live Git/worktree state, current decision and architecture authorities, AGENTS/CLAUDE rule wiring, lifecycle hooks, role registries, generated projections, gate output, and orchestration backlog. Open raw outputs; report evidence-backed discrepancies and exact next actions only. Never inspect secrets, customer data, transcripts, recordings, raw provider payloads, or telemetry bodies. Do not edit, commit, push, merge, deploy, delete, purchase, mutate production, submit browser actions, or contact anyone.

createAtBootstrap.name: Voice Agent Platform weekly fleet doctrine review
createAtBootstrap.prompt: Read-only weekly fleet and doctrine review. Inspect tracked commits, current role/rule/gate authorities, journey lessons, architecture blast radius, decisions, and open backlog. Identify recurring failure classes with the three-question RCA and recommend at most three reusable controls. Never inspect credentials, customer data, transcripts, recordings, raw payloads, or telemetry bodies; never mutate any repository or external system.
